image_description: A close-up, high-angle view of a large crocodile resting on a concrete or stone bank next to water. The image focuses primarily on the posterior half of the animal, showing the muscular tail, hind legs, and armored dorsal scales. The head is visible in the upper right but is partially cropped and out of focus compared to the tail.
